explanations.rule: A trigger block (limit, trigger, allowed, available, visible and the like) accepts only triggers the game documents, scripted triggers that a loaded file defines, and scope changes.
explanations.fix: Check `{name}` against the game's trigger documentation: correct the name, use the trigger that tests the value, or move an effect out of the trigger block.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: An effect block (immediate, option, completion_reward, effect and the like) accepts only effects the game documents, scripted effects that a loaded file defines, and scope changes.
explanations.fix: Check `{name}` against the game's effect documentation: correct the name, or define the scripted effect it was meant to call.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: The parser met `{name}` where it expects an effect, and no documented effect or loaded scripted effect has that name.
explanations.fix: Correct `{name}` to a documented effect, or define the scripted effect in common/scripted_effects/.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: The parser met `{name}` where it expects a trigger, and no documented trigger, loaded scripted trigger or scope change has that name.
explanations.fix: Correct `{name}` to a documented trigger, or define the scripted trigger in common/scripted_triggers/. A country tag works here only if the tag exists and the block accepts a scope change.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: Each block accepts a fixed set of keys. A key the parser does not expect is usually misspelled, placed in the wrong block, or left outside its block by a missing or extra brace.
explanations.fix: Check that `{name}` belongs in this block, and that the braces before it are balanced. hoi4.script_validate on the file points at an unbalanced brace.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: unexpected token in file: "(?<file>[^"]+)" near line: (?<line>\d+)
explanations.rule: The game could not read the file from this point on. A missing or extra brace, a missing `=` or an unclosed quote above the named line causes this, and what follows the problem is lost.
explanations.fix: Find the unbalanced brace or quote above line {line}. hoi4.script_validate on the file reports where parsing breaks.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: InitPostRead failed in file: "(?<file>[^"]+)" in object\(s\) between line\(s\): (?<line>\d+) and (?<end>\d+)
explanations.rule: An object in the file failed to load because of an earlier error, which the log names on the line before this one.
explanations.fix: Fix the error the log reports just before this line for the same file and lines {line} to {end}; this line goes away with it.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A modifier, or another key the interface shows, has no text in the current language.
explanations.fix: Add `{key}` to a UTF-8 file with a byte order mark under localisation/<language>/, or correct the name that produces the key.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A sub-unit or unit-category modifier names a sub-unit or category that no loaded file defines.
explanations.fix: Correct the sub-unit or category name in `{name}`, or define it under common/units/.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^(?<file>\S+\.txt):(?<line>\d+): advisor role created via script cannot contain any effects or triggers
explanations.rule: An advisor role that a script effect creates cannot carry effects or triggers (such as on_add, on_remove or allowed). Only an advisor role defined in common/characters/ can.
explanations.fix: Define the character and its advisor role in common/characters/ and recruit it from the script, or remove the effects and triggers from the role the script creates.
explanations.evidence: Message text in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A ship's model is looked up by an entity name, and no loaded .asset file defines `{name}`.
explanations.fix: Define the entity `{name}` in a gfx/entities/*.asset file, or correct the model name the equipment or variant uses.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A model attaches another entity by name, and no loaded .asset file defines `{name}`.
explanations.fix: Define the entity `{name}` in a gfx/entities/*.asset file, or correct the attachment's name.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: Text writes an icon with `£{name}`, which the game draws from the sprite `GFX_{name}`, and no loaded .gfx file defines that sprite.
explanations.fix: Define `GFX_{name}` in an interface/*.gfx file, or correct the icon name after `£` in the localisation.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^(?<tag>[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}) - is not in the tag list
explanations.rule: Script names the country tag `{tag}`, which common/country_tags/ does not define for this game.
explanations.fix: Define `{tag}` in a common/country_tags/ file, or correct the tag.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: The game expected a country tag and read `{tag}`. A value that is not a tag here (such as `{` or `color`) means a block above it is malformed.
explanations.fix: If `{tag}` is a tag, define it in common/country_tags/. Otherwise check the braces and keys just before it.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: Script names the country tag `{tag}`, which common/country_tags/ does not define.
explanations.fix: Define `{tag}` in common/country_tags/, or correct it. A tag made at run time needs a saved scope or a variable instead of the bare tag.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^Default rule '(?<name>[^']+)' replaces '(?<other>[^']+)' that has previously been set as default for '(?<group>[^']+)' in '(?<owner>[^']+)'
explanations.rule: `{owner}` sets two default rules of the faction rule group `{group}`, and the later one, `{name}`, replaces `{other}`. A group has one default rule.
explanations.fix: List one rule of the group `{group}` in the `default_rules` of `{owner}`: keep `{name}` or `{other}`, not both.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28); rule groups and default_rules in common/factions/_documentation.md

explanations.pattern: ^Province (?:for icon )?is invalid or added twice to the (?:same or )?different rules: (?<province>\d+)
explanations.rule: Province {province} is listed in more than one map rule of the same kind, or does not exist.
explanations.fix: List province {province} in one rule only, and check that it exists in map/definition.csv.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^Trying to move navy to land province with no port: (?<province>\d+)
explanations.rule: A fleet's location must be a sea province or a province with a naval base. Province {province} is land without a port.
explanations.fix: Set the fleet's `location` to a province with a naval base, or build one there in the state's history.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: `{name}` runs in a scope it does not support. It supports: {scopes}.
explanations.fix: Wrap `{name}` in a scope change to a supported scope, or move it to a block that runs in one. hoi4.script_validate on the file shows the scope at each line.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: `{name}` ran in a {scope} scope, which it does not support.
explanations.fix: Change the scope before `{name}`, or use the {scope}-scope variant of the command. hoi4.script_validate on the file shows the scope at each line.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^sp:(?<name>\S+) does not match any Special Project in database
explanations.rule: Script names the special project `{name}`, which no file under common/special_projects/ defines.
explanations.fix: Define `{name}` under common/special_projects/, or correct the name after `sp:`.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: invalid database object for effect/trigger:\s+file: (?<file>\S+) line: (?<line>\d+) (?<name>\S+)\. use var:
explanations.rule: `{name}` is not a database object (such as a state, country or character). A variable used where the game expects one needs the `var:` prefix.
explanations.fix: Write `var:{name}` if `{name}` is a variable; otherwise correct the name.
explanations.evidence: Message text in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: ^Not a valid compare token in trigger '(?<token>[^']+)' from (?<file>\S+\.\w+) line ?: ?(?<line>\d+)
explanations.rule: This trigger compares a value and does not accept `{token}` as its comparison.
explanations.fix: Use the comparison the trigger documents, usually `>` or `<` for a number.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: The variable `{name}` has no value in the scope that reads it at this point.
explanations.fix: Set `{name}` in this scope before it is read, read it from the scope that holds it, or give the read a default.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A collection input with operators is an inner block: `input = { input = {name} operators = { ... } }`. Written flat, the game reads `{name}` as a named collection without a name, and `operators` as an unknown trigger.
explanations.fix: Move `input = {name}` and its `operators` into an inner `input = { ... }` block, as the game's script_collection_input documentation shows.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28); documentation/script_collection_input.md, game scope

explanations.pattern: ^(?<file>\S+\.txt):(?<line>\d+): Missing or invalid requirements for raid type '(?<name>[^']+)'
explanations.rule: The raid `{name}` lacks a valid requirements block, or the block names something that is not defined.
explanations.fix: Check the raid's requirements against the game's raid documentation, with hoi4.system_inspect kind raid.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: The game has loc key collisions
explanations.rule: Two localisation files define the same key in one language; one of them wins and the other text is lost.
explanations.fix: Run hoi4.localisation_inspect with mode audit to list the duplicated keys, then keep one definition of each, or move the override to localisation/<language>/replace/.
explanations.evidence: Message text in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: The division template `{name}` could not be read, usually because it names a sub-unit that does not exist or breaks the designer's grid.
explanations.fix: Check the template with hoi4.unit_inspect kind oob, which lists unknown sub-units and grid problems.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.rule: A terrain's unit modifiers name the sub-unit `{name}`, which no loaded file defines.
explanations.fix: Define `{name}` under common/units/, or remove it from the terrain's unit modifiers.
explanations.evidence: Message shape in the game's error.log, build 99a5ee557 (2026-10-28)

explanations.pattern: Event is triggered only, but does not have a 1 base-factor
explanations.rule: `mean_time_to_happen` only works for an event that fires by itself, and an event with `is_triggered_only = yes` never does.
explanations.fix: Remove `mean_time_to_happen`, or remove `is_triggered_only` if the event is meant to fire by itself.
explanations.evidence: HOI4 wiki, Event modding > Common mistakes > Unintuitive logged errors

explanations.pattern: Event is set to trigger every day
explanations.rule: An event that fires by itself, can fire more than once and has a mean time to happen of one day or less (one day when omitted) may fire every day once its trigger is true.
explanations.fix: Add `is_triggered_only = yes` and fire it from an effect or on_action, add `fire_only_once = yes`, or set the mean time to happen to 2 days or more.
explanations.evidence: HOI4 wiki, Event modding > Common mistakes > Unintuitive logged errors
